offerings.name: Search (/search)
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: 实时搜索结果（标准结果/Highlights/Structured outputs/AI Summary）
offerings.note: 超过10个结果按$1/1k results加收；AI page summaries $1/1k pages；另有 Instant/Fast/Auto/Deep 等延迟档。

offerings.note: deep-reasoning $15/1k；deep-lite ~4s, deep 4-15s, deep-reasoning 12-40s；额外结果与摘要同标准搜索。

offerings.name: Answer (/answer)

offerings.name: Monitors (/monitors)

offerings.name: Agent API
